Description: Urbanway 12 m with natural gas: Cursor 9 NG (310 PS / 1300 Nm), 4.63 final drive. Uses the CNG engine and tanks of the Wentward Pack, which must be installed. ZF EcoLife 6-speed automatic with output retarder (auto mode with the brake pedal, levels on Alt+Y / Alt+H), speed limiter at 100 km/h.
